observation: The small culvert on the drainage channel route reaching the river is undersized.
action_required: Demolish the existing culvert and construct a larger one.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: The bridge-crossing culvert on the drainage channel route to the river needs strengthening.
action_required: Strengthen the culvert, revet the culvert slopes in concrete and pour concrete at the culvert inlet and outlet.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: Site clearing has started in places but the vegetal topsoil has not been stripped.
action_required: Strip a minimum of 10 cm of vegetal topsoil so no vegetation remains.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: Existing trees within the site remain in place and prevent construction.
action_required: Remove the existing trees as part of the site preparation works.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: The WCs in the existing building are not usable: the water supply and drainage are not connected.
action_required: Make the WCs serviceable by connecting the water supply and drainage.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: The electrical installation of the existing building is a danger to life in the rooms and around them.
action_required: Only qualified and certified electricians may work on the installation. Improve the distribution board, lighting and sockets before the building is energised.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: The electricity subscription for the existing building has not been restarted. Recorded as URGENT in the site report.
action_required: Restart the electricity supply contract for the building.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: Driving and pull-out tests were carried out at six points nominated by TOZZI SUD using a 3.60 m C profile. The detailed report has been prepared but not yet issued.
action_required: Issue the pull-out test report so the required pile embedment depth can be confirmed.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: No clear work plan or programme has been provided by TOZZI SUD.
action_required: Issue the construction programme required by Sub-Clause 8.3 of the EPC Contract.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)

observation: Only two items of plant are working on site, carrying out site clearing. This is not sufficient for the works.
action_required: Mobilise an adequate plant fleet including dozer, grader and trucks.
source: Site report no. 0 dated 27.08.2026 (Behcet Kocak, GNCR Holding)
